name: AgentBill
description: One spend ceiling per session. Every model turn and tool call consults it before it runs; when the ceiling is spent the call is refused and the session says so.

apiKey.description: AgentBill API key (agb_...). Omit to read AGENTBILL_API_KEY from the Gateway environment.

ceilingUnits.description: Ceiling for one session, in units. With units=tokens the default is 500,000 tokens. Applied when the session's task is opened; raise or lower it later from the console at /app.

units.description: What one unit is. tokens: every model call records the usage total OpenClaw reports. calls: every model call and tool call is one unit.

estimateUnits.description: Units reserved before a call whose cost is not yet known. Defaults to 2000 for tokens and 1 for calls; after the first model call the plugin uses a running average of what this session actually spent.

toolCallUnits.description: Units recorded per tool call. Defaults to 0 for tokens (the model call around the tool is what costs) and 1 for calls.

taskRefPrefix.description: Prefix for the task_ref the plugin opens per session. The task_ref is the prefix followed by the session key.

agentId.description: Agent identifier the events are attributed to in the AgentBill console.

customerFrom.description: Which OpenClaw identity becomes the AgentBill customer, for per-customer attribution in the console.

failMode.description: What happens when AgentBill cannot be reached. closed refuses the call and says why. open lets it run and logs the failure. A ceiling that fails open is not a ceiling, so the default is closed.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for AgentBill calls. Kept under OpenClaw's 15 second gate budget.
